classes.name: SNRIs
classes.description: Venlafaxine IR/ER (tablet and capsule), desvenlafaxine (Pristiq), duloxetine (Cymbalta, Drizalma), levomilnacipran (Fetzima).
classes.plainDescription: A daily antidepressant that also helps some nerve pain.

classes.name: Bupropion
classes.description: Bupropion IR, SR, XL (Wellbutrin, Wellbutrin XL, Forfivo XL, Aplenzin); exclude Zyban labeling for smoking cessation and naltrexone/bupropion (Contrave).
classes.plainDescription: A daily antidepressant that does not usually cause weight gain or sexual side effects.

classes.name: Other antidepressants
classes.description: Mirtazapine (Remeron, ODT), trazodone, vilazodone (Viibryd), vortioxetine (Trintellix), dextromethorphan/bupropion (Auvelity), nefazodone.
classes.plainDescription: Other daily antidepressants, including ones often used at night for sleep.

preferredAgent.sig: Depression or anxiety: 30 mg once daily for 1 week, then 60 mg once daily. Nerve pain or fibromyalgia: 60 mg once daily (may start at 30 mg) (label).

preferredAgent.plainSig: One capsule a day; the dose usually goes up after a week.

records.verificationNote: Read PDL p.43 (SNRI heading). Listed with no PA: duloxetine DR 20/30/60 mg, venlafaxine IR/ER, desvenlafaxine ER. Not on PDL: Cymbalta, Drizalma, Pristiq, Fetzima/levomilnacipran (not coded nonformulary). Judgment: duloxetine 60 mg as the common generic SNRI for depression and nerve pain.

preferredAgent.sig: 150 mg once daily in the morning for at least 4 days, then 300 mg once daily if needed; max 450 mg/day (label).

records.verificationNote: Read PDL p.43 (NDRI heading). Generic bupropion IR, SR and XL all listed with no PA. Wellbutrin, Wellbutrin XL, Forfivo XL and Aplenzin not listed (not coded nonformulary). The SR 150 mg tablet on PDL p.43 appears under the smoking-deterrent heading (H7N); not counted as an antidepressant alternative. Zyban and Contrave excluded per class definition.

records.verificationNote: Read PDL pp.43, 46. Mirtazapine and trazodone listed with no PA. Vilazodone (age 18+) listed no PA. Trintellix listed Auto PA. Judgment: mirtazapine 15 mg as the lowest-cost common generic; trazodone is an equally defensible pick.
